name: Aster da Master API
for_agents: Start at api/v1/index.json. The artist record is the source of truth; data/artist.json feeds the site renderer.
provenance: All artist facts verified against public platform pages (Apple Music, iHeart, Anghami, Shazam, Boomplay, SonicHits, album.link, SoundCloud). v0.5.0: the official SoundCloud profile (asterdamaster) catalog is fully verified — 185 SoundCloud-only tracks (upload dates + play-count snapshot) alongside the 34 distributor releases (219 total). Spotify is artist-linked via the official SoundCloud bio; Instagram + official site likewise bio-linked. 'Litemode Trilogy' is teased in the bio, not confirmed. v0.7.0: global-search slug index + on-this-day (MM-DD) API; homepage gains search overlay, on-this-day section, era intelligence deep-dives, and cast-lots.
